description: Evidence requirements for Demo, Beta, Release Candidate and Production maturity claims.

evidence_categories.real_service: The path calls a real service or executable implementation; hard-coded success and placeholder results are excluded.
evidence_categories.persistence: State survives process restart and is stored in the declared durable system.
evidence_categories.deterministic_data: A versioned fixture, synthetic scenario or replay dataset produces reproducible outputs.
evidence_categories.positive_negative_paths: Success, validation failure, timeout/cancel and retry or recovery paths are tested as applicable.
evidence_categories.rbac_tenant: Authentication, permission and cross-tenant denial tests pass.
evidence_categories.audit: Security- and business-relevant actions create attributable audit records.
evidence_categories.observability: Health, metrics, structured logs and actionable alert/recovery behavior are verified.
evidence_categories.performance: A bounded performance baseline passes declared latency, throughput and error thresholds.
evidence_categories.recovery: Restart, queue retry and/or backup restore behavior passes a documented drill.
evidence_categories.e2e: A user-visible end-to-end lifecycle passes against the integrated platform.
evidence_categories.cleanup: Regression assets, jobs, deployments and temporary files are deterministically removed.
evidence_categories.production_data: A governed representative production or approved anonymized sample has passed distribution validation.
evidence_categories.field_acceptance: The accountable business and site owners accepted the defined success criteria.
evidence_categories.long_run: The module passed the declared continuous-operation and fault-injection window.
evidence_categories.reproducible_release: The tested revision can be rebuilt and deployed from immutable versioned artifacts.
